annotations.title: Maturities, dependencies, liquidity and oracle evidence for one vault

description: The risk evidence a decision needs first for one vault, each item with how it was established: PT collateral maturities (date from the contract’s expiry() where read, else the ticker and marked unverified; share of the allocation and of TVL; what a PT does at maturity), look-through dependencies (exposure summed by economic underlying, direct and through PT/SY/ERC-4626 wrappers, each link proven on chain, inferred from the name, or unknown), the five liquidity figures with their denominators and times (never summed), oracle evidence (feed, round, answer, update time, stale check, sequencer on an L2; an unidentified oracle type is unknown, not a pass), incident candidates (a ticker match to a reported incident, never a proven cause) and which curator powers act at once. With the report’s executive summary as fields. Cut from the due-diligence document, the same one the PDF prints. Free. A maturity is borrowers’ collateral reaching its date: never call it a default, a liquidation or a loss.
name: vault_risk_evidence

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

decisionBrief.description: The report’s two-page decision brief as fields (2026-11-26), built on executiveSummary: identity; status (bandIs model | overlay | withheld, oldestMaterialInputAt and what it was, coverage complete | partial | limited, the decision gate); keyFindings (3 to 5, each with its appendix section); notEstablished; liquidity by type (never summed); risks; bandLayers (model, overlay, final); matrix (six rows market, liquidity, concentration, control, operational, evidence, each assessed | partial | not_assessed, risk null where not assessed, never low or 0, coverage and asOf); delta (changes since the previous issued report, null without one).

executiveSummary.description: The report’s first pages as fields: what, finding, band (never positive when withheld or not usable), decisionRows (item, value, source, asOf, state, decisionEffect), notExamined, changes (comparable or not).

liquidity.description: rows (one per figure, with denominator, asOf, block, holder, state), competition, neverSum.

lookThrough.description: underlyings with direct and indirect shares and each path’s link evidence; modelGap; coverLine.

maturities.description: rows, nearTerm, nearest, coverLine, says; since 2026-11-27 coverageStatus (not_read | partial | complete) and coverage {marketsRead, capitalInMarketsReadUsd, uncoveredCapitalUsd, says}: with no market read, `says` says PT exposure cannot be determined, never that no market lends against PT.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

oracles.description: Per market, state read | typed | unknown.

powerDelays.description: Each curator power by its delay: read, immediate (delay 0), delayed, abdicated, notRead, says. Null where the powers were not read.

says.description: What this answer holds; none of it enters the score and none is a loss estimate.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: Maturities, dependencies, liquidity and oracle evidence for one vault
